mainEntity.name: Which Jaguar XF engines do you work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on XF diesel and petrol engines across both generations, including the 2.2 diesel, 2.7 TDV6, 3.0 V6 diesel and Ingenium units.

mainEntity.name: How much is a Jaguar XF engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour involved. We quote after assessing your XF rather than giving a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a Jaguar XF reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better route, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your XF's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Is a 2.7 TDV6 engine worth rebuilding?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be, if the main components are sound. We inspect the engine first and only recommend a rebuild when it makes practical sense.

mainEntity.name: Does my XF have a timing belt or chain?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the engine. The 2.2 diesel and V6 diesels generally use belts, while Ingenium engines use chains. We can confirm for your car.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XF engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my XF from anywhere in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer UK-wide collection and delivery from our Essex workshop, so your XF can reach us wherever you are based.
